question_text:
Which revision corrects the double negative in this sentence from a Pasig City grievance response?
"The supervisor said he couldn't find no errors in the report."
A. The supervisor said he couldn't find any errors in the report.
B. The supervisor said he couldn't find no errors in the report.
C. The supervisor said he could find no errors in the report.
D. The supervisor said he couldn't find errors in the report.

options.text: The supervisor said he couldn't find any errors in the report.
The supervisor said he couldn't find no errors in the report.
The supervisor said he could find no errors in the report.
The supervisor said he couldn't find errors in the report.
